boundary: E2 controlled-runtime on synthetic seeded revisions in a loopback session; layout and contrast of painted rows only, no claim that a model or host ran.
howItSettles: The gate writes a second revision through the same route the screen uses (.../revisions with expected_revision), opens #as-compare, selects r1 and r2, clicks 对照 and waits on #as-compare-body having >= 12 rows while #as-compare-status no longer says 正在读回 and is not a failure. The state field is then read off that status line, not hard-coded.
note: notInView=3 recurs here for the same reason recorded in 5.44 (the long assistant screen scrolls the topbar above the viewport); it is a named observation, not an occlusion, and the sticky question stays with the owner.
whyThisState: DL-KB-12 accepts on "a comparison page over two REAL revisions". The panel that says so only paints after a second revision exists and 对照 is pressed, so a run that leaves the details closed never renders the twelve lined-up fields this receipt is about.
